## Cameras with Real-Time AI Analysis

Hard Hat, Uniform and Station cameras follow electrical installers, the concrete crew and the lift crew as they build a data center.

![Station Camera](https://www.sitevue.ai/station-camera.jpg)

Station Camera

Mounts on scaffolding, a pole or a site trailer over the generator yard, pads and laydown areas. Move it inside during MEP and fit-out to cover data halls and electrical rooms.

![SiteVue hard hat camera giving a first-person view of an operator's work](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/699f61a6ef80db724a0c588c/b08c86cd-88a4-4e97-82ea-c0e382e2966c/IMG_2962.jpg)

Hard Hat Camera

Mounts on the worker's hard hat for a first-person view. Ideal for inspections, safety audits and trade work like cable pulls and terminations.

![SiteVue uniform-clipped wearable camera on a production operator](https://www.sitevue.ai/uniform-camera-bg-treated.jpg)

Uniform Camera

Clips to a high-visibility vest for hands-free capture. Easy to roll out across large crews, with no changes to the site.

![SiteVue camera built into standard PPE safety glasses for hands-free first-person capture](https://www.sitevue.ai/safety-glasses-camera.jpg)

Safety Glasses Camera

Built into standard safety glasses for a true first-person view. Lightweight, with no extra gear for the crew to wear.

## See What's Actually Happening on Your Site

SiteVue records the work as it happens, from the first pad pour to the last cable termination. AI analysis turns that video into progress, crew time, near misses and QA/QC checks for each trade and zone.

The dashboard keeps current and past data with the video behind it, so you can fix issues, settle questions with footage and hold each contractor to the same standard. Installs in days, with no software integration required. Managers trained in under an hour.

## How SiteVue Helps Data Center Builders

- ### Track Installation Progress by Area


Compare visible installation milestones with the project plan across data halls and equipment yards. Review the footage behind observed progress.
[See it working](https://showcase.demos.sitevue.ai/#/digital-twin)
- ### Find Delays Between Trades


See where crews wait for materials, access, or preceding work. Use timestamped footage to identify the constraint and coordinate the next handoff.

- ### Document Work Before It Is Covered


Preserve footage of installation steps before walls, ceilings, or equipment conceal them. Link video with inspection records for quality and rework reviews.

- ### Monitor Lift Zones and Restricted Areas


Flag entry into barricaded lift zones and review activity in controlled work areas. Keep footage of the event and crew response.
[See it working](https://showcase.demos.sitevue.ai/#/safety)
- ### Retrieve a Video Record of Site Work


Find dated footage of installation sequence, site access, and delays. Use the relevant record to answer questions during handover or a dispute.

FAQs

## Construction FAQs

### How long does setup take?

SiteVue installs in days, with no software integration required, and runs independently of your IT systems. Cameras move with the work as the job goes from site work to fit-out.

### Is any hardware or software integration required?

No. SiteVue provides all hardware and software as part of your monthly subscription. We only need to connect our hardware to one internet location.

### Is SiteVue easy to use?

Yes. Managers are trained on the SiteVue dashboard in under an hour.

### What types of cameras does SiteVue offer?

SiteVue offers station, hard hat, uniform and safety glasses cameras. Mix them to fit each trade and area, and change the mix as the job moves.

### Can owners and GCs require cameras for every contractor?

Yes. Owners and GCs can make SiteVue cameras a condition of site access, so each contractor and vendor is measured against the same standards.

### Can the hardware handle an active jobsite?

Yes. SiteVue cameras are built for active job sites. During the site visit, our team confirms the right camera and mounting for each area, including dust, heat and weather.

### Is worker footage kept private?

Yes. SiteVue captures no audio, processes video in a closed system, independent of your IT infrastructure, and uses worker footage for operational metrics only. Footage can be blurred.

### How does SiteVue charge?

SiteVue charges a monthly subscription per camera, which covers the equipment and AI model training. A one-time setup fee applies per camera. Annual billing is available, and you can cancel anytime.
